profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer - Frontend
profile.summary: My goal is to create beautiful and functional UI that helps users solve their problems.

positions.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
•  Worked with the founders to design and implement on-call management. Added features and fixes to the workflows for Triage, Prepare, and Handoff. 
•  Rewrote the home page to show the user an overview of their teams, what they are on-call for, and recent things that could affect their on-call stint.
•  Collaborated with an outside design firm on UI for new and existing features. Provided feedback on initial designs and implementation detail alterations to keep the designs up to date with the current product. 
•  Used Lookbook to create and maintain UI components, allowing for a consistent look and feel as well as faster development.
•  Made improvements in internationalization and accessibility, including responsive UI for different sizes of browser and mobile use.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · UI · Cross-team Collaboration

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sr. Software Engineer  Oct 2016-Feb 2023
Software Engineer  Jan 2014-Oct 2016
•  Refactored a number of administration management pages from XML to modern JavaScript frameworks, which improved performance, reliability, and maintainability. 
•  Coordinated development with UX, PM, Legal, and Backend teams to implement useful and compliant product interfaces, while following UX design guidelines. 
•  Rewrote app installation and management interfaces in JavaScript and React and set them up as microservices to allow for continuous deployment. 
•  Added features to several administration management pages, which gave Splunk Admins more control over how their Splunk installations worked. Worked with PM and Backend teams to coordinate feature rollout and compatibility.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Google Web Server: Part of the Search Results Page UI revamp. Worked on the footer refresh,
preferences page, and the mobile search results. Also wrote and maintained tools for internal UI and feature development.
• Google Shopping: Part of the team that launched Apparel. Wrote restricts so users could select by
color, size, brand, gender, and age. Coordinated with remote offices to make sure apparel restrict data was present and in the correct format both to show users and to send to the backend. Also did the initial work to rewrite/port the Shopping results page to the Google Web Server. Then helped the rest of the team to get up to speed on the new code and get the page polished for launching. Launched the Video Games and Accessories verticals. This included creating new UIs, working with teams in remote offices to make sure the data was in the correct format, and working with the translation team to get UK and DE launched.
• Google Search Appliance: Mini 2.2 release, rewrote the Batch Crawler and the Crawl Status Page.
Also updated the crawler to correctly crawl NFS files. Maintained continuous builds. Included adding new test builds for new code branches, as well as writing documentation and setting up a rotation so that other people could maintain the continuous builds.

positions.title: Release Engineer
positions.description:
Ran twice weekly builds of the Google Search Appliance. Made sure the build passed basic
automated tests before handing it off to QA. Wrote and maintained code to gather all third party licenses that needed to be published with the Google Search Appliance.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Wrote a test server for SSO logging on the Google Search Appliance.
• Took over maintenance on the regression test framework for the Google Search Appliance.
Updated the framework with longevity and reliability tests and started it running nightly. 
• Wrote a set of Python scripts that automate creating and deleting AdWords campaigns. Maintained these scripts and added them to the nightly build.
• Designed and wrote the test plan for Opera for Adsense. Led the testing on that feature.
• Did a large variety of automated and manual testing for various Google products including AdWords, AdSense, Google Web Server, Toolbar, and internal Ad approval tools.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Section Leader for CS 5 (introductory Computer Science), Grader for CS 4 (webpage design).
Graded problem sets and exams. Ran evening lab hours: tutored and provided problem set help. Led a weekly one-hour recitation section, teaching up to ten students

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software Developer Engineer Intern with the Seller-Tools Group.
Designed and implemented a Document Broker to facilitate communication between Amazon and its partner merchants using XML, SOAP, and C++.

positions.title: Co-Author
positions.description: Co-authored Instructor’s Manual of Introduction to Algorithms, 2nd edition by Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, & Stein. Wrote and edited lecture notes and problem solutions in LaTeX.
